# `aitbc blockchain delete`

Delete a chain permanently after confirmation.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain delete [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--force` | flag | `false` | no | Force deletion without confirmation |
| `--confirm` | flag | `false` | no | Confirm deletion |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain delete --chain-id <chain_id>
```
